clues.text: Rachel named Bilhah's first son this, saying God had vindicated her and heard her plea.
Jacob blessed this son as a snake by the road, a viper biting the horse's heels.
In his final blessing on the tribes, Moses called this tribe a lion's cub leaping out of Bashan.
Oholiab, the skilled helper God chose to work with Bezalel on the tabernacle, belonged to this tribe.
All Israel, from this city to Beersheba, knew that Samuel was confirmed as a prophet.
The city once called Laish was renamed after the forefather of the people who settled there, a son of Israel.
Samson's father Manoah, a man of Zorah whose wife was barren, came from the clan of this tribe.
